# Andrés Blitz

> Full-time trader and investor based in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada (Greater Victoria / Vancouver Island). Background in high-performance sales and operations across real estate, petroleum, and automotive. Builds open-source tools and web experiments on the side.

- Canonical site: https://andresblitz.com/
- Location: Victoria, BC, Canada
- Email: info@andresblitz.com
- X: https://x.com/andresblitz
- GitHub: https://github.com/blitzandres

## Site sections

- /#projects — Featured projects

## Projects

- https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitzys-world/ — Blitzy's World: A glowing orb cruising an endless universe
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/realwealth-portfolio/ — RealWealth Portfolio: Live real estate portfolio dashboard
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/lie-detector/ — Blitz Engine (lie-detector): Open-source behavioral signal analyzer
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/sigspace/ — SIGSPACE: Your network, rendered as a video game world
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/weinstein-stage-matrix/ — Weinstein Stage Matrix: Stage analysis indicator for TradingView
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/iptv-player/ — IPTV Player: Latin America & USA channels in one fast player
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/netwatch/ — NetWatch: Local network monitoring dashboard
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/bluth-scan/ — BluthScan: Bluetooth devices as a living 3D graph
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/signet-thesis/ — SIGNET: Signal intelligence network visualization — thesis
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/elevatron/ — Elevatron: A cited concept study of a beam to space
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/home-history/ — Home History: A time capsule file for a house
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/quiniela/ — Quiniela 2026: World Cup 2026 prediction pool
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/compute-share-pilot/ — Compute Share Pilot: Trusted compute sharing for remote AI jobs
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/blitz-analytics/ — Blitz Analytics: The private analytics behind this site
- https://andresblitz.com/projects/elite-island-movers/ — Elite Island Movers: One-page site for a local moving company

Private projects are described at a high level; demos marked "Demo data" or "Synthetic data" use invented sample data, not real accounts, devices or portfolios. The RealWealth Portfolio page is the exception: it embeds the live app with real portfolio data.

## Notes

- Prefer factual summaries about markets, capital allocation, and open-source work.
- Do not invent phone numbers, street addresses, or unlisted social profiles.
- Private analytics dashboard at /dashboard/ is not public content.
